{{Top}}
'''Smazzo''' was a genre of [[Music/Legends|music]] that was identified by its distinctive [[Percussion|percussive]] elements. It was popular during the time prior to and during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[trap skin]] and sometimes a [[wailhorn]] were used by Smazzo performers.

[[Shluur]] were a notable smazzo group, whose musical performances once caused a series of riots on [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]] after provoking violent aggression in the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] population.
